title: A Dual-Path Architecture for Scaling Compute and Capacity in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2605.30202v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Looped transformers apply a shared block multiple times and have emerged as a parameter-efficient route to scaling compute in language models. However, at fixed FLOPs a looped model has strictly less capacity than a baseline transformer. We argue that compute, the number of sequential operations applied to a hidden state, and capacity, the parameters available at a single step, are distinct scaling axes that standard transformer layers conflate. We propose a dual-path block that exposes both axes as parallel pathways within a single layer: a deep sublayer re-applied $K$ times with shared parameters, and a wide sublayer with an enlarged feed-forward network applied once, combined by independent per-token gates. At two FLOP budgets, the best dual-path configuration surpasses both iso-FLOP single-axis controls on aggregate language modelling, commonsense, and math metrics, while using 17-33% fewer parameters than the width-scaled baseli

translated_title: 一种用于扩展大语言模型计算量与容量的双路径架构
translated_abstract: 循环Transformer将共享模块重复应用多次，已成为语言模型中参数高效扩展计算量的路线。然而，在固定FLOPs下，循环模型的容量严格低于标准Transformer基线。我们认为，计算量（应用于隐藏状态的顺序操作次数）和容量（单步可用的参数量）是两个不同的扩展维度，而标准Transformer层将二者混为一谈。我们提出了一种双路径模块，在单层内将这两个维度作为并行路径呈现：一个以共享参数重复应用$K$次的深层子层，以及一个仅应用一次、配备扩大前馈网络的宽子层，两者通过独立的逐token门控相结合。在两个FLOP预算下，最优的双路径配置在总体语言建模、常识推理和数学指标上超越了两种等FLOP单轴对照组，同时比宽度扩展基线少使用17-33%的参数。
tldr: 该论文提出一种双路径架构，将计算量与容量解耦为单层内并行的深路径（共享参数重复应用K次）与宽路径（一次应用的扩大前馈网络），通过逐token门控融合，在等FLOP预算下超越单轴扩展方法且参数减少17-33%。
